decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-9ddb01602beb], is a one-line changelog entry: "Log TLS client subject". It names no CLI flag, Helm value or config field. It also does not say whether the subject is logged by default or only when a field or option is enabled, or that it only appears for connections that present client certificates. The proposed condition (--accesslog set, or Helm value accessLog set) comes from outside knowledge, not the evidence, and the validator was inconclusive. Deciding this needs the PR #9285 diff or the access-log documentation that shows the new field name, its default and the configuration that enables it.
